definition: the building where politicians make laws
description: Inside a large circular legislative chamber. A woman in a black suit stands among the seated members and raises her hand to vote. The camera pulls back to show the whole hall: hundreds of members in curved rows of desks, packed public balconies above, everyone standing and applauding. A man then speaks from the podium at the centre while the seated members listen.
